visualCharacteristics.purpose: Text-only cards, each with a title, description and CTA link
visualCharacteristics.description: Repeating structure of title/description/CTA items without images. Option tile: filled #f3f3f3 tile (white on light-blue sections) with a notched bottom-right corner, no orange rule, optional badge image and eyebrow, outlined pill CTA; add cta-arrow for the tertiary text + arrow CTA (ETF fund tiles).

contentPattern.description: 4 items: Approach, Awards, Insights, Responsibility - each title, description, CTA link
contentPattern.structure: one row per card; single cell with title (heading), description paragraph and CTA link; the tile option adds an optional leading badge image and a short eyebrow paragraph (e.g. ticker) before the title, and only the last single-line link-only paragraph is the CTA
rows: Per card: text cell - (stats) bold value paragraph + caption paragraph; (links) title, description, CTA link

usage.description: Link hubs pointing to related sections (Approach, Awards, Insights, Responsibility).

reuseGuidance: Use for navigational card grids without images. The last link-only paragraph is treated as the CTA. Use the tile option for contact, office or fund tiles; other link-only lines (e.g. 'Contact us via email') stay plain links, and multi-line links (addresses with line breaks) are never the CTA.
